Answer: B
Reason: The complete white-out of the left hemithorax combined with a mediastinal shift to the right (away from the affected side) is characteristic of a massive pleural effusion or pyopneumothorax, which exerts a mass effect pushing structures to the contralateral side. In contrast, lung collapse or atelectasis would typically cause the mediastinum to shift toward the affected side due to volume loss.
